ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 82% high-intensity (white) pixels to 18% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central white contiguous blob covering the main body of both lobes; black contiguous bands mapping to the entire trailing edge and tips; discrete black circular spots clustered in the upper-outer quadrants of both lobes (approx. 10 on left, 25 on right).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle of approximately 38 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 15% of the visible vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 20 pixels; right lobe trailing edge exhibits deeper, more irregular valleys compared to the left lobe; visible jaggedness along the entire boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edges terminating in pointed lateral tips; leading edges exhibit a wide convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 35 circular, low-intensity pixel clusters concentrated in the upper-lateral white fields of both lobes, particularly high density on the right fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel and intersecting reddish-brown linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally on the lower-central regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation and missing tissue on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe; vertical reddish linear mark extending from the median notch base.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized area of reddish-brown pigmentation/staining concentrated at the lower point of fluke convergence near the water line.
